checks.title: Physical microphone recording and transcript acceptance
checks.instructions: After all automated Slice 06 QA passes, start an explicit audio recording on the supported Jarvis host, speak for at least 30 seconds with pauses, stop it, then inspect/play the recorded media and the timestamped transcript projection.
checks.expected: The recording is obviously active while running, stops cleanly, the saved media is complete enough to play through, transcript ordering/time alignment is plausible, and any real loss is shown as a gap/partial condition rather than hidden.
